corrections.reason: The word split across L09-L10 is ከዚሁም ('more than this'). The 2nd-order vowel mark on ሁ was slightly faint and misread as ሀ.
Joined with L21 ለሁላ-, the printed word is ለሁላቱም ('for both of them', referring to the Father and the Son). The crossbar of ቱ was misread as ቹ.
Classical Ge'ez imperfect subjunctive of አክበረ with 3ms object suffix is ያከብርዎ (with 1st-order ከ, matching ያከብርዎ on the very next line).
The printed Amharic demonstrative is ይኸኛው ('this [resurrection of the flesh]'), contrasting with ከትንሣኤ ልቡና on L26. The top crown of ኸ was blurred by ink bleed and misread as ገ.
